card.name: Needle gauge and tablet strength slashes
card.fires_on: The slash in combined-strength ratios such as 85/500 mg or 50/50 mixtures, and the digit 1 after a 2 in needle gauges like 21-gauge. Also the word Type in USP Type 1 glass.
